claim: The Bakery holds up to 40 Bread. The decoded balance of 5 Flour + 4 Stick → 40 Bread is a whole-number ratio (1 Flour + 0.8 Stick per 8 Bread), not a batch of 40 produced at once.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report, 25 October 2026. The 40 Bread figure shown by earlier builds of this wiki was the ratio artifact; a 40-unit capacity is reported from play.

notes: Storage capacities are not decoded for any building. Pages now show ratios per primary input. A controlled test should confirm the Bakery capacity and record capacities for other production buildings.
